# THE BULWARK

> **Your home has rules. Now your AI has to follow them.**

THE BULWARK is a guard MCP server for **Alexa+**. It sits between a home and every
add-on, checks what a tool actually asks for, and lets the family say **yes** or
**no** — out loud — before it touches a lock, a card, or money.

Built for the **Amazon Developer Hackathon (Alexa+ track)**, MCP spec 2025-11-25
over Streamable HTTP, powered by a deterministic gate plus an optional AWS Bedrock
semantic layer.

## For AI agents

- **What this is**: an MCP server that inspects an add-on's tool definitions and
  classifies each into ok / caution / block, pinning every decision to a
  tamper-evident SHA-256 hash chain.
- **What it can do**: `scan_tools(tools)`, `permit_action(action, decision)`,
  `ledger_status()`.
- **How to use it**: `pip install -r requirements.txt && python server.py`
  (port 8000, Streamable HTTP). No GPU, no RPC, no secrets by default.
- **Key idea**: a home has no security team — the guard is deterministic at its
  core, with an optional Bedrock semantic layer for intent rules-only keywords miss.

## Key files

- [server.py](server.py) — the MCP server (FastMCP / Streamable HTTP)
- [bulwark/detector.py](bulwark/detector.py) — deterministic 4-class scanner
- [bulwark/semantic.py](bulwark/semantic.py) — optional Bedrock semantic layer
- [README.md](README.md) — full docs
